senses.definition: In golf, the implement used to hit the golf ball.
senses.example: Once the tough job is done for Prosser, he says he can then get his golf clubs back out - they have been in the cupboard untouched for a decade.

senses.definition: A club (organization and its campus) where golf is played.
senses.example: Meronyms: golf course, putting green, clubhouse
